segments.contextAfter: The [`studio_lighting_armode_v002.exr`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/sample-code/ar/studio_lighting_armode_v002.exr) file provides enhanced highlights according to AR Quick Look’s new lighting environment in AR mode. This IBL is appropriate for use in your AR app as a combination with an environment texture that composes captures of the user’s environment.
